en: Dependent on a non-conflictive, non-causal state, a non-conflictive causal state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-conflictive, non-causal state, a conflictive causal state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
There are two under root [condition] … pe … two under non-disappearance [condition].
Dependent on a non-conflictive (anāsava) state that is not a root-cause, a non-conflictive state that is not a root-cause arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a non-conflictive state that is not a root-cause, a non-conflictive state that is not a root-cause arises by way of root-condition.

Dependent on a non-conflictive state that is not a root-cause, a conflictive state that is not a root-cause arises by way of root-condition. Dependent on a non-conflictive state that is not a root-cause... [and so forth].

Dependent on states with conflict (*saraṇa*) and states that are neither cause nor without conflict (*na-hetu ca araṇo ca na-hetu*), states that are neither cause nor without conflict arise by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*).
... [Three] (Abbreviated). Under the root condition there are four; under the object condition two ... pe ... under the resultant condition one ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition four.
